adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts`, `createEvent(credential, calEvent, externalId?)` passes only `(calEvent, credential.id)` into the calendar integration (`calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`) and never uses `externalId` to influence which calendar the event is created in, only echoing it back in the returned result (`externalId, credentialId`). In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, calendar selection is based on `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, and if that lookup fails it falls back to `"primary"`. Meanwhile, `packages/core/EventManager.ts` records `externalCalendarId: result.externalId`. Therefore, if the integration falls back to `primary` (e.g., no matching destinationCalendar for that credential), references can store an `externalCalendarId` that does not correspond to the calendar actually used to create the event.
